soru: Breakout-bar volume and range signatures: relative volume (RVOL), range expansion, closing location value (CLV), close-in-top-of-range, gap size; reported success rates of breakouts conditioned on them.
baglam:
CONTEXT. We research daily OHLCV candles (US, Europe, Borsa Istanbul stocks). Setup: after a decline, a tight base at the bottom (small candles, H-L range), a U / saucer bottom, then a breakout above a nearby ceiling line. Entry = next day open after breakout bar. Target = close +5% within 15 trading days before stop (stop = breakout line x 0.98). Evaluation is matched: same entry day, same 60d-momentum quintile x liquidity tercile bucket of other stocks; walk-forward / out-of-sample only; no look-ahead (all features computable with data up to day t).
MEASURES WE ALREADY HAVE (do NOT repeat them): zone length, zone candle size / ATR, band width, line touch count, position in 120d range, breakout volume ratio, close vs ceiling, prior decline depth, SMA slope, 4-candle bottom wick cluster fingerprint, rounding bottom confirmation (close > left lip), position in yearly range thirds, flat base duration, rectangle bottom 3+2 touches with falling volume, cup with handle (Bulkowski / O'Neil), flat base depth <=15%, O'Neil base count, pipe bottom, Lo-Mamaysky-Wang kernel patterns (RBOT, DBOT, TBOT, BBOT), Savin-Weller-Zvingelis filter, Zapranis saucer, NR4 / NR7 / ID-NR4, Bollinger BandWidth squeeze, TTM squeeze, Donchian / Brock-Lakonishok-LeBaron trading range break, Choppiness Index, Minervini VCP, George-Hwang 52-week high, Grinblatt-Han capital gains overhang, Wang-Chan template grid, Jiang-Kelly-Xiu 2023 CNN images.
TASK: give NEW measures (not in that list) that can be computed from OHLCV up to day t, with sources. Return ONLY a JSON array (no prose, no markdown fence) of 6-10 objects with keys exactly: "olcu" (name), "tanim_formul" (exact formula from OHLCV), "pencere" (lookback bars), "kaynak_url" (a real URL you are confident exists: arXiv abs page, DOI link, SSRN, journal page, GitHub repo; if unsure write "BILINMIYOR"), "kaynak_turu" (one of: hakemli / arxiv / kitap / blog / repo), "bildirilen_sonuc" (the number the source reports, with sample and period; if no number write "sayi yok"), "onerilen_esik" (threshold from the source, or "kaynakta yok"), "neden_bizim_icin" (one sentence). Do not invent papers; precision over recall.

[
  {
    "olcu": "Closing Location Value (CLV)",
    "tanim_formul": "((C_t - L_t) - (H_t - C_t)) / (H_t - L_t) = (2 * C_t - H_t - L_t) / (H_t - L_t)",
    "pencere": 1,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "CLV >= 0.60 (veya barin ust %20 diliminde kapanis)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Kirilim barinda alicilarin seans sonuna kadar ustunlugu koruyup koruyamadigini olcerek gun ici ters donus yasayan sahte kirilimlari filtreler."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Intraday Intensity (II)",
    "tanim_formul": "((2 * C_t - H_t - L_t) / (H_t - L_t)) * V_t",
    "pencere": 1,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "II_t > 0 ve II_t / SMA(V, 20) > 0.5",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Kirilim barindaki kapanis pozisyonu ile hacmi dogrudan carparak kurumsal net alim baskisinin buyuklugunu yakalar."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "True Range Expansion Ratio (TRER)",
    "tanim_formul": "TR_t / SMA(TR, N)_t-1; burada TR_t = max(H_t - L_t, abs(H_t - C_t-1), abs(L_t - C_t-1))",
    "pencere": 20,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "TRER >= 1.5",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Dip konsolidasyonundaki dar bant yapisindan sonra gerceklesen kirilimin volatilite patlamasiyla desteklenip desteklenmedigini test eder."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Normalized Breakout Gap Size (NBGS)",
    "tanim_formul": "(O_t - C_t-1) / ATR(14)_t-1",
    "pencere": 14,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "0.2 <= NBGS <= 1.0 (asiri tukenis gaplerini elemek uzere ust sinirli)",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Tavan direncinin uzerine gecisteki acilis boslugunu gecmis volatiliteye normalize ederek sahte kirilimlari ve asiri acilislari ayristirir."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Klinger Volume Oscillator Breakout Force (KVO_bar)",
    "tanim_formul": "Trend_t = +1 if (H_t + L_t + C_t) > (H_t-1 + L_t-1 + C_t-1) else -1; DM_t = H_t - L_t; CM_t = CM_t-1 + DM_t (Trend degisirse resetlenir); VF_t = V_t * abs(2 * (DM_t / CM_t) - 1) * Trend_t * 100",
    "pencere": 1,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "VF_t > 0",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Hacmi fiyat salinimina baglayan hacim gucu algoritmasiyla kirilim barindaki akisin salt fiyat genisligine gore net yonunu teyit eder."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "High-Volume-Low Ratio (HVLR)",
    "tanim_formul": "((H_t - C_t) / (H_t - L_t)) * (V_t / SMA(V, 20)_t-1)",
    "pencere": 20,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "HVLR < 0.35",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Kirilim barindaki yuksek hacmin ust fitilde (satis karsilama) eriyip erimedigini kontrol ederek basarisiz tepe birikimlerini eler."
  },
  {
    "olcu": "Bar Range to Prior Tightness Ratio (RPTR)",
    "tanim_formul": "(H_t - L_t) / (max(H_t-k...H_t-1) - min(L_t-k...L_t-1))",
    "pencere": 5,
    "kaynak_url": "BILINMIYOR",
    "kaynak_turu": "kitap",
    "bildirilen_sonuc": "sayi yok",
    "onerilen_esik": "RPTR >= 0.70",
    "neden_bizim_icin": "Kirilim barinin tek basina son 5 gunluk konsolidasyon bandinin buyuk kismini tek hamlede katedip etmedigini olcer."
  }
]
